signals.source_text: A converted Cessna Caravan completed a 3,199-mile flight across the United States without its onboard safety pilot touching the controls. Joby Aviation ’s system managed taxi, takeoff, en-route weather diversions, and landing—supervised remotely from up to 2,323 miles away. Here is what actually matters: while the sector watches the slow regulatory march of clean-sheet aircraft, autonomous retrofits on existing airframes are operating in active airspace today. Built on tech Joby absorbed from Xwing, the aircraft navigated busy airspace at Phoenix Deer Valley and rerouted around storms on the fly. For cargo carriers and military planners, this is the practical play. Automating workhorse turboprops tackles pilot bottlenecks and contested resupply logistics right now, using airframes regulators already understand. #MachIntelligence #AutonomousFlight #DefenseLogistics
